newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian initiates Siderar.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian initiates Siderar.

text.p: - Caspian Securities initiated coverage of Argentine steelmaker Siderar as market performer.
- Caspian has a 12-month price target of $3.30 per share, amounting to a total return of 13.2 percent, including a dividend yield of 1.7 percent. The stock currently trades at $3.09.

- "Siderar represents a low risk/medium return vehicle into the Argentina market. Siderar offers long-term growth prospects through capacity expansions in FY 2001 and the possibility of even stronger growth if the company acquires a stake in (Venezuelan state steel firm) Sidor," said Caspian.
- Siderar trades at an estimated FY98 price/earnings ratio of 10.9 times, a 10 percent discount to the market.
